hardware: 2x Intel Arc B580 (GPU0 x8, GPU1 x4 PCIe, ~21 GB/s aggregate, no L0 P2P)
optimizations_applied: DMA batch reduction: STRATA_DMA_BATCH=64 for lower latency on x4 link
VRAM mirror cut: STRATA_MIRROR_MIB=8192 for OOM safety on 12GB
Asymmetric PCIe split mode + MoE DMA overlap
Async ring buffer + chunked fill + KV prefetch

tensor_parallel_tp2.notes: Asymmetric x8/x4 PCIe bus contention during ring-allreduce limits token generation.

pipeline_parallel_pp2.notes: Optimal configuration for asymmetric B580 x8/x4 topology with chunked prefill pipelining.

targets.physical_ceiling_reason: Consumer PCIe x8/x4 aggregate bandwidth (~21 GB/s) physically limits memory-bound MoE bandwidth requirements (~440 GB/s for 50 tok/s).
targets.conclusion: Targets unachievable on current hardware without native P2P/GPU-direct or HBM cards.
